title: Overly open CORS (python) — review required
description: Cross-origin sharing in python is opened wide: CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINSs*=s*True. Any site can then read responses with the victim's ambient credentials where credentials are allowed, or probe APIs otherwise. This lexical rule flags the opening; the reviewer confirms the scope or narrows it.
remediation: List exact trusted origins (CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS listing) and avoid credentials with wildcards.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches open CORS regardless of credential settings. Framework allow_origins forms are separate rules.
